profile.headline: Web Developer | Javascript, ReactJS, GraphQL
profile.summary: I'm a web developer specializing in building and maintaining front-end web applications. I also dabble in UI/UX, wiring up content management systems, and metrics collection and analysis. I believe in the importance of building applications that are both beautiful and accessible and I'm passionate about designing and writing clean, user-friendly, and efficient web applications.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
+ Develop new features and components on 12+ websites that utilize modern web frameworks and libraries including React, GatsbyJS, and Next.js.
+ Design and implement layouts and style components using a variety of style libraries including Material UI, Styled Components, and Tailwind CSS.
+ Fix bugs from 12+ both newly developed and existing websites to improve user engagement and performance, utilizing running local builds, Github issues, version control, and peer-reviews of code.
+ Audit and implement improvements pertaining to web accessibility according to WCAG guidelines, using Lighthouse reports, color-contrast checkers, and coordinating with UNC’s Digital Accessibility office; check and maintain multi-device responsiveness using media queries and built-in responsive features of CSS libraries such as Material UI
+ Design, create, and maintain content on a monthly, sometimes weekly, basis for a Wordpress site; built custom field and post types to manage re-occurring events and content.
+ Contribute to marketing strategy for RENCI-related initiatives and collaborate with graphic design and project management teams on a wide range of projects.
